catalysts.headline: bioAffinity reports Q2 2026 results: net revenue $1,510,579 (+19% YoY); CyPath Lung test volume +216% YoY; H1 2026 revenue $2,862,106 (-8.4% YoY); longitudinal CyPath Lung clinical trial begins patient enrollment at 11 sites (9 VA)
catalysts.impact: Strong CyPath Lung-specific growth, though total company revenue (including other lines) declined for the six-month period
